limitations.detail: CURRENT oracle role joint_query and GT-free oracle roles A/B imply different seeds because role enters seed hash. Oracle bounds contrast includes finite optimizer sampling differences. Main RGBD same-role bounds contrasts remain seed-matched. Do not silently change frozen seed; report limitation. BOUNDS_STATUS must rely on paired RGBD evidence only, never interpret oracle CURRENT-minus-GT-free as a pure bounds causal effect. Context RGBD-versus-QUERY_ORACLE at matching GT-free role also uses distinct track-derived seeds, in addition to different supervision; it is a diagnostic gap.
Loader and phase gates constrain the frozen execution path; they are not OS-level filesystem authorization or cryptographically authenticated phase markers.

reasoning.bounds: 34 float64 camera-only reconstructions match locked GT-free boxes exactly; all state and chain boxes match the two identities. Original shared context anchor, TRAIN q01/q99 prior, no current-scene depth/query camera.
reasoning.phase_order: CLI context completion precedes oracle gate via context evaluation PASS; secondary requires primary analysis PASS. Evaluator requires every planned phase state/completion hash and all CPU state seals before media hashing/query access.
reasoning.plateau: CLI objective=.001 gradient=.10 match prereg lock; last10% with full objective every100 and gradient every10; descriptive, never early stopping.
reasoning.prefix: A single local Generator with frozen scene|role|track seed drives one uninterrupted Adam trajectory to 10000. 1000/3000 outputs are copied prefix states; context-selected uses only full supervision checkpoints <= each budget, strict less-than earliest tie. No optimizer changes or reseeding at budgets.
reasoning.query_isolation: ContextOnlyLoader filters private media record to context IDs; RGB_ONLY removes depth paths and cannot request query. Only explicit oracle branch obtains query-supervised batch, gated after complete context evaluation. Optimizer has no query loader or score argument.
reasoning.source_integrity: All 11 configured source files and 7 preregistered input hashes match. Runner revalidates before and after each chain; evaluator rechecks frozen source/plan/config/completion/state/summary hashes.

review_scope: Read-only source/config/metadata audit; no formal media or query score access; no frozen source modifications
